instructions: Which kind of work is the user asking for in `request`?

criteria.coding: write, debug or explain software code, scripts or SQL (not ASME/API codes)
criteria.mathematics: solve a calculation, equation, proof or unit conversion with numbers
criteria.reasoning: weigh a decision: compare options, trade-offs, risks or root causes
criteria.tool-calling: emit machine-readable JSON, schema output or function-call arguments
criteria.research: summarise or extract findings from documents, reports, papers or manuals
criteria.general: greeting, thanks, small talk, general knowledge, or a follow-up with no task
